name: AN|DES – Before After Image Slider
author: BelleWeb Studio

sections.description:
AN|DES is a responsive Before After Image Slider and Image Comparison Slider plugin for WordPress. It helps beauty salons, wellness centers, hair salons, aesthetic clinics, dentists, and other businesses present visual results clearly without writing code.

The visual editor lets you select images from the WordPress media library, configure labels and appearance, choose a layout and movement direction, and preview the result before publishing. You can create individual comparisons and comparison galleries, insert them with shortcodes, and present them across desktop, tablet, and mobile screens.

Main features

  • Visual editor for creating and managing comparisons.
  • Responsive layouts for desktop, tablet, and mobile.
  • Individual comparisons and basic comparison galleries.
  • Reusable shortcodes for pages, posts, and other areas that accept shortcodes.
  • Horizontal, vertical, and square display formats.
  • Left-to-right and top-to-bottom slider movement.
  • Configurable Before and After labels, colors, border radius, and divider appearance.
  • Image selection through the WordPress media library.
  • Admin preview and quick preview from the comparison list.
  • Notice when the two images do not share the same proportion.
  • Frontend assets load only on pages that contain a supported shortcode.

Use cases

AN|DES is designed for businesses that need to explain visual changes clearly. Beauty salons can present treatment results, hair salons can compare styles or color work, wellness and aesthetic centers can organize client-authorized images, and dental practices or other professionals can publish visual comparisons managed on their own WordPress site.

Shortcodes

[andes id="123"]

Displays one comparison. Replace 123 with the comparison ID shown in the WordPress admin.

[andes_gallery]

Displays a basic gallery of published comparisons.

Legacy aliases

[bellebefore id="123"]

[bellebefore_gallery]

These aliases remain available for compatibility with existing content.

Privacy and Client Images

AN|DES lets site owners publish before-and-after images on their own WordPress site. If images include identifiable people, the site owner is responsible for having the appropriate permission to publish them.

AN|DES does not send client images or usage data to BelleWeb or other external servers. Images remain in the WordPress media library and are handled by the website owner’s WordPress installation. The plugin does not include telemetry or load remote SDKs or resources.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the andes-de-belleweb folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate AN|DES from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  3. Create a comparison from the AN|DES menu in the WordPress admin.
  4. Add [andes id="123"] to a page, replacing 123 with the comparison ID.
  5. Add [andes_gallery] to display a basic gallery of published comparisons.
sections.faq:
What can I create with AN|DES?

You can create individual before-and-after comparisons and basic galleries of published comparisons.

Do I need to write code?

No. Configure the comparison in the visual editor, then insert it where you want it with a shortcode.

Is the comparison responsive?

Yes. The comparison adapts to desktop, tablet, and mobile screens.

How do I add a comparison to a page?

Add [andes id="123"] to a page, post, or other area that accepts shortcodes, replacing 123 with the comparison ID shown in the WordPress admin.

Are the old BelleBefore shortcodes still supported?

Yes. [bellebefore id="123"] and [bellebefore_gallery] remain available as compatibility aliases for existing content.

Does AN|DES send client images or usage data to BelleWeb?

No. AN|DES does not send client images or usage data to BelleWeb. Images remain in the WordPress media library and are handled by the website owner’s WordPress installation.

Can I use different colors for each comparison?

In this Lite version, visual colors and slider style settings are global and apply to all comparisons.

Does it include a reminder about client image authorization?

Yes. The admin interface includes a discreet reminder to make sure you have permission before publishing client images.
